inputs_contract: acceptance kit proof layers and gate context
decision_protocol: Continue in `qa` when implementation evidence exists and acceptance truth is frozen.
Route back to `implement` for execution gaps, to `change` for truth drift, or to `test-case` when coverage truth is insufficient.

`qa` cannot rewrite frozen truth or override gate truth by itself.

Stale learning should bias toward re-verification, not trust.

story_sequence.text: Beacon defines a governed QA evo-deep output contract with source refs, finding type, risk, affected ACs, route recommendation, blocked admissions, and release supplement input.
QA evo-deep records prior QA round memory as advisory influence only and never counts it as current pass evidence.
QA evo-deep supports state-machine, business-flow, scenario-combination, permission-boundary, data-source-consistency, cross-surface-closure, and repeated-failure finding families.
QA evo-deep detailed output writes to `docs/beacon/<version>/qa/evo-deep/<feature>.md`; research stores only index or design-input summaries.
Skill Eval Kit defines auditable cases with id, prompt, expected route, boundary expectations, source anchors, tags, split, expected evidence, and scoring dimensions.
Skill Eval Kit defines optimization and holdout splits plus a small regression core that can be run before skill or harness release.
Skill Eval Kit run outputs are runtime or machine evidence only and do not become requirement truth.
Skill Eval Kit includes route-stability cases for ordinary support skills, `beacon-deep`, `beacon-learn`, and `beacon-implement --mode single/team/ralph`.
Requirement clarity or release readiness fails closed if QA evo-deep or Skill Eval output claims PRD, user-story, test-case, QA verdict, release verdict, or freeze authority.

anti_inertia_notes: `qa` is the only public verification entry, but it is not allowed to rewrite frozen truth silently.
Passing one layer does not imply release readiness.
Browser or live-environment blockers must be recorded explicitly, not masked as product failure.
`qa` cannot rewrite frozen truth or override gate truth by itself.
learning_notes: Reuse prior QA findings as hint for scenario prioritization.
Learning can highlight likely failure modes, but it cannot convert blocked evidence into pass.
Stale learning should bias toward re-verification, not trust.
backstop_cli: `beacon release ...` only after layered evidence is sufficient
decision_surface.primary_reason: Continue in `qa` when implementation evidence exists and acceptance truth is frozen.
